source.quote_free_summary: Mixed Amateur is confined to amateurs partnering other than their regular amateur partner: an advanced amateur competitor/teacher partnering an amateur who is their student; both must be registered Amateur Competitors.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must check the regular-partner and teacher/student relationship and amateur registration. Studio/Custom 'Mixed partnership' checks none of it.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA partnership and registration checks. The generic Studio/Custom model must not carry it, and it must NOT block eligible Studio/Custom competitions; it belongs to a future body profile.
